title: PolicyLens directional-measure verdict (e.g. immigration) — reports DIRECTION of change, NO good/bad valence

shift.description: which way the policy moves immigration / border control. This is NOT a judgement that the move is good or bad — only its direction.

magnitude.description: how big the shift; 'n/a' iff shift is 'no material change' or 'unclear'

plain.description: 1-2 sentences, ~age-12: which way it moves things and the main caveat. Do NOT imply the move is good or bad.

biggest_unknown.description: one sentence — the main caveat / what would change the read

claims.description: the EVIDENCE-BOUND factual backbone — every factual assertion tied to a provided evidence unit and quoting a verbatim span from its snippet.

quote.description: VERBATIM span from the cited evidence unit's snippet

rationale.description: reasoning connecting the claims to the shift, plain English, interpretation only. Describe the directional effect; do not editorialise on whether it is desirable.
